newsitem.title: THAILAND: Cogeneration to sell power to EGAT. [CORRECTED 4:45 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Cogeneration to sell power to EGAT. [CORRECTED 4:45 GMT]

text.p: The Cogeneration Plc said on Monday that its affiliates had signed contracts to sell a total of 300 megawatts of electricity to state-run Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand (EGAT). (Corrects from PTT Exploration and Production PLC (PTTEP))
The Cogeneration said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand that its affiliates the Thai Cogeneration Co Ltd and MTP Cogeneration Co Ltd signed contracts with the EGAT on Friday for the sale.
Under the contracts, Thai Cogeneration would sell 180 megawatts of elctricity for 25 years while MTP Cogeneration would sell 120 megawats, also for 25 years, it said.
